import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

repo=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/rollout-20261007")
branch="feat/staged-runtime-rollout-20261007"
expected="a02b9979c083bb223a017bdb75e58e8223d43705"

def run(args, check=True):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check)

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
current=run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout.splitlines()
tracked_dirty=[x for x in status if not x.startswith("?? ")]
if head!=expected or current!="main" or tracked_dirty:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected source state head={head} branch={current} tracked_dirty={tracked_dirty}")

if wt.exists():
    raise SystemExit(f"target worktree already exists: {wt}")

fetch=run(["git","fetch","origin","main"],check=False)
print(fetch.stdout); print(fetch.stderr)
if fetch.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(fetch.returncode)
origin_main=run(["git","rev-parse","origin/main"]).stdout.strip()
if origin_main!=expected:
    raise SystemExit(f"origin/main moved unexpectedly: {origin_main}")

existing=run(["git","show-ref","--verify",f"refs/heads/{branch}"],check=False)
if existing.returncode==0:
    raise SystemExit(f"branch already exists: {branch}")

add=run(["git","worktree","add","-b",branch,str(wt),expected],check=False)
print("=== worktree add stdout ==="); print(add.stdout)
print("=== worktree add stderr ==="); print(add.stderr)
if add.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(add.returncode)

def wrun(args, check=True):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check)

print("wt_branch="+wrun(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip())
print("wt_head="+wrun(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("wt_status="+repr(wrun(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
